result.rationale: The diff adds route `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"` in config/routes.rb, but the new spec at groups_controller_spec.rb:115 uses `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42` for the automatic-group test (the passing member-removal test correctly uses `xhr :delete`). Rails controller specs dispatch directly to the action regardless of verb, so the test passes while never exercising the actual DELETE route — a real, verifiable defect in the newly added test introduced by this diff.
